name: Spicy Tuna Caesar Smash
notes:
Tuna on a Caesar base. Cottage cheese and Greek yoghurt make the base, jalapeños bring the heat, and it piles up well on toast.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 100g tinned tuna in spring water
• 100g full-fat cottage cheese
• 60g Greek yoghurt
• 3 anchovies
• 1 tsp Dijon mustard
• 1 garlic clove
• 30g Parmesan
• 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
• 30g pickled jalapeños
• ½ lemon
• 100g cherry tomatoes
• 10g fresh basil
• 1 red onion
• 2 slices sourdough
• Black pepper

Method:
1. Drain the tuna, then add it to a large bowl with the cottage cheese and yoghurt.
2. Finely chop the anchovies and jalapeños and halve the cherry tomatoes. Grate the garlic and finely grate the Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the Dijon, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice, and tear in the basil. If you're using it, finely dice a little red onion and add that too.
3. Mix until creamy but still chunky. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper and stir until thick and scoopable.
4. Toast the sourdough, pile the mixture on top and serve. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 4g, fibre 3g, sugars 4g, sodium 1022mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/spicy-tuna-caesar-high-protein-smash
